notes: VERSION: all numbers come from the cached arXiv v1 preprint (2404.09787v1, 4 pp, compiled 2024-04-16); the Optics Letters version of record (49(14) 3870, issued 2024-07-03 per Crossref) was not read and may differ. Frequency-upconversion demonstration: a C-band push-pull TFLN MZM (7.3 mm) followed by a 7 mm PPLN SHG section; two rows, the modulated fundamental harmonic (FH, 1536 nm) and the second harmonic (SH, 768 nm) of the same chip. repro_grade C and no sim config: crystal cut, propagation direction, ground-electrode width, sidewall angle and cladding are not stated and the paper shows no MZM cross-section (the SEM is of the poled waveguide). Judgment calls: Vpi 2.5 V is the authors' value for both FH and SH (7.3 mm is the stated MZI modulator length, electrode length not stated), measured with unterminated electrodes at low frequency. SH bandwidth 40 GHz is the authors' claim, entered without a qualifier with bw_measured_to 40 (the SH trace ends at 40 GHz): the authors say it is limited by the VNA noise floor and not by the device (abstract and p.3 say VNA noise floor, conclusion says photodiode range); the Fig. 3(c) SH trace reaches the -3 dB line near 30 GHz and dips to about -3.9 dB near 35-36 GHz before recovering to about -0.3 dB at 40 GHz. Not reported: insertion loss of the MZM, optical input power, Z0, RF loss, crystal cut, cladding. Grating-coupler efficiencies (-4 dB at 1550 nm, -7 dB at 775 nm), SHG conversion efficiency 35 %/W measured (ideal 2100 %/W, theory 4280 %/W/cm^2), PPLN period 2.48 um and 7 mm PPLN length are kept in notes only. Fabrication: ETH Zurich cleanrooms FIRST and BRNC and IBM Rueschlikon thanked for fabrication support; BRNC and FIRST are both entered as foundry_or_fab because the paper does not say which facility made which layer; IBM Rueschlikon is a company and is not entered. Batch CSV hints (40 GHz, 46 dB) verified; the CSV platform and priority are fine. Audit corrections 2026-10-03: see AUDIT_DISPOSITIONS.md.
